text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 101,194 to 95,338 overall, so I should assess total portfolio risk rather than focus on individual trade prices.","Selling some shares did not prevent continued declines; I should make measured, diversified adjustments instead of assuming a sale alone controls risk.","Monthly changes can be unsettling, but I should avoid reacting to each dip and stick to a plan that preserves retirement funds and maintains suitable cash."]}
